contexts.text: A lust for conjunction. Signified, Explained.
If they conjoin themselves with internal truth they do it from lust like that of conjunction with a harlot... AC 4868:3, Example(s).
To be conjoined with one's wife from lust alone is natural and not spiritual...
Confess them with the mouth for the sake of the lust of exercising command and of gain.
From the judge, etc... the lust of dominating invaded many like a contagion.
There is still the lust of contact.
For in all evil there is the lust of seducing...
The lust of building is then kindled.
The angelic love of the sex... is devoid of all allurement from lust.
They are cast down lest their lust should defile the aura there.
Who spurn and detest wandering lusts.
Merely natural marriages... are conjunctions which originate from unchaste lust.
In proportion as a consort shuns these conjunctions, even as to the lusts of the will... this love is purified with them...
We both look together, and then not one whit of lust can enter...
There issued (from the women's apartment) a libidinous effluvium... This was from polygamous love.
Meanwhile the beginning of that love is like lust...
They regard each other... with favour... while in lust.
Extorted consent... may initiate the body; and thus turns chastity... into lust, by which conjugial love is vitiated in its first heat.
I have heard that... the lust of defloration, and the lust of variety, have led the minds of some into the desire for repeated marriages.
Both public and private peace require that promiscuous lust in general should be restrained, and be left to everyone within his own house. Hence polygamy.
Hence it is that all in Hell are in the lust, lasciviousness, and shamelessness of scortatory love.
(These things) are nothing but the effervescences of lusts...
The love of the sex... becomes spiritual when the man recedes from wandering lust...
That fornication is lust, but not the lust of adultery. General article.
In everything which proceeds from the natural man there are concupiscence and lust; for the natural man is nothing else than an abode and receptacle of concupiscences and lusts.
Lust (then) becomes human love.
Those who... cannot moderate their lusts...
(Various lusts of married men.) Enumerated.
That adulteries of the second degree are adulteries of lust... General article.
On the lust of defloration. Chapter.

The lusts treated of in the four following chapters are not only lusts of adultery, but are more grievous... They are called lusts, because according to the quantity and quality of the lust for these things, such is their appropriation.
On the lust of varieties. Chapter. CL 507. CL 508. CL 509.
On the lust of violation. Chapter.
On the lust of seducing innocences. Chapter. SE 3896.
Joking about lovers as if from lust.
Living lustfully even to adultery.
Whereas the love of the will... is immersed... in the libidinous things of the senses.
He who looketh on a girl with lust has scortated already.
